# Workforce Pay Equity Dashboard: Fix Guide

**Status:** Prepared, NOT yet applied to the .pbix. Do these steps in Power BI Desktop, then check section 5.

## 1\. What changed in the data (done)

* `scripts/analysis.py`: salary bands changed from 20,000 to 120,000 bins to 25,000 to 65,000 bins. The original left "Very High" with 0 employees and "High" with 4 (all male).
* `data/cleaned\\\_pay\\\_equity.csv`: regenerated by running the fixed script. Band counts: Low 47, Medium 139, High 99, Very High 15. Other columns are unchanged.
* `data/pay\\\_equity\\\_synthetic.csv`: unchanged.

## 2\. Refresh the dashboard

1. Save a backup copy of the .pbix.
2. Open `dashboard/workforce\\\_pay\\\_equity\\\_dashboard.pbix`.
3. Home > Transform data > Data source settings. Point the `cleaned\\\_pay\\\_equity` source to `data/cleaned\\\_pay\\\_equity.csv` in the project folder. Click **Close**.
4. Click **Refresh**. The SalaryBand column updates from the new file.

## 3\. Add measures

Home > New measure, one per block in `dax/measures.dax`. Then build the cards and the gap visual below.

## 4\. Page structure and titles (single page kept)

The dashboard has one page with eight visuals. Keep one page. The existing layout works.

**Page title text box:** `Workforce Pay Equity Overview`

**Subtitle text box:** `Observed salary differences in a synthetic dataset of 300 employees. Differences are descriptive and do not establish cause.`

**Disclaimer text box (small, bottom):** `Synthetic data for portfolio use. Not evidence of discrimination.`

|#|Current visual|Fix|Visual title (exact text)|
|-|-|-|-|
|1|Card: Total Employees|Retitle; fix typo "Empolyees" and stray quotes|Total Employees|
|2|Pie: Gender by employee count|Retitle|Employee Split by Gender|
|3|Column: Gender, Avg Salary|Retitle; use \[Avg Salary]|Average Salary by Gender|
|4|Bar: Department, Avg Salary|Retitle|Average Salary by Department|
|5|Column: Gender, Min Salary|Retitle|Minimum Salary by Gender|
|6|Column: Gender, Max Salary|Retitle|Maximum Salary by Gender|
|7|Bar: SalaryBand by Gender (count)|Retitle; Very High now shows 15|Salary Band Distribution by Gender|
|8|Scatter: Experience vs Salary|Retitle|Experience vs Salary (one point per employee)|

Remove the stray apostrophes in the titles of cards 1, 7, and 8 when you retitle them.

**New card (optional, recommended):** add a card with \[Observed Gap (F-M)] titled `Observed Average Gap (Female minus Male)`. Its subtitle should read "Descriptive only; no statistical test."
